statement:
by
  classical
  let S := fun {r s : ℕ} (α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r) (β : DirichletCharacter ℂ s) (m : ℕ) =>
    ∑' q : ℕ, if hq : q ≠ 0 then
      let _ : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
      if h : r ∣ q ∧ s ∣ q then
        let A := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.1 α
        let B := DirichletCharacter.changeLevel h.2 β
        gaussSum A ZMod.stdAddChar * gaussSum B ZMod.stdAddChar *
          gaussSum (A*B)⁻¹ (ZMod.stdAddChar.mulShift (-(m:ZMod q))) / (q.totient:ℂ)^2
      else 0
    else 0
  let O := S (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1)
  exact ∀ (D r : ℕ) [NeZero D] [NeZero r], r ∣ D → ∀ α : DirichletCharacter ℂ r, α.IsPrimitive → ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → Even m → ∃ F : Finset (Σ s : ℕ, DirichletCharacter ℂ s), (∀ b, b ∈ F ↔ b.1 ≠ 0 ∧ b.1 ∣ D ∧ b.2.IsPrimitive) ∧ (∑ b ∈ F, ‖S α b.2 m‖ ^ 2) = ‖O m‖ ^ 2 * ∏ p ∈ D.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ m), (((p:ℝ)-1)/((p:ℝ)-2))

plain_statement.zh: 对共同模数 D 内全部原始搭档，求扭曲奇异级数平方和的精确 Euler 乘积。
plain_statement.en: An exact level-dependent quadratic mass formula for all primitive partners.

brief.zh: #4245 对任意有限搭档只需证明提升是单射。本题要求证明全体导子整除 D 的原始搭档恰覆盖模 D 特征，进而把局部 Parseval 等式组装为全局等式。结果量化二次矩随共同模数增长的代价，可用于截断大弧误差。
brief.en: Upgrade the injection in #4245 to a bijection for the full family of primitive origins at level D. Combine row orthogonality with the global factorization, retaining the prime factors of D missing from the target.
